description: RPE-based load adjustment table + silent adaptation signals. Applied after every session by the rules engine. No LLM needed.

autoregulationTable.condition: All reps clean, RPE below target
autoregulationTable.notes: User is adapting. Push the load.

autoregulationTable.condition: All reps clean, at target RPE
autoregulationTable.notes: On track. Micro-load for continued progress.

autoregulationTable.condition: All reps clean, RPE above target
autoregulationTable.notes: Weight is right but user is working harder than intended. Consolidate.
Weight is slightly ahead of capacity. Retry next session.
Too heavy. Drop back and rebuild.

silentAdaptationSignals.signal: All sets completed for 2-3 consecutive sessions

silentAdaptationSignals.action: Check for pain. If none, swap for equivalent.
Fitness improving. Current programming is working.
Fatigue accumulating. Consider pulling deload forward.
Hold progression. If 1+ week gap, consider regression.
Program too aggressive. Reduce weight by 2.5kg or drop 1 set.

beginnerToIntermediate.skillBuilder: 8+ pull-ups, 15+ dips, 60s wall HS, 15s tuck L-sit, 10 skin the cats
beginnerToIntermediate.hybridAthlete: 8+ pull-ups, 12+ dips, 45s wall HS, 10s tuck L-sit, 10 skin the cats

rampUpPercentages.description: Applied to ADDED working weight, not total load.
